# Epoch — ResonantOS add-on (time estimation)

A read-only estimation service for your machine: PERT, COCOMO II, Monte Carlo
schedule simulation, sprint forecasting, business-day math, time math, and
token cost estimation — the mathematics of Epoch v0.5.0 packaged as a
ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha local-service add-on. It is a pure calculator. Upstream's
feedback/self-improvement machinery is excluded by construction and nothing is
ever persisted: every call is a synchronous request-response, done in under a
second (a 100k-iteration Monte Carlo runs in about 130 ms).

## Canonical links

- This repo: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-epoch
- Canonical upstream: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Epoch (Apache-2.0, v0.5.0 pinned)

## Key facts

- ResonantOS 2.0.0-alpha add-on; validator: 0 errors / 0 warnings
- License: Apache-2.0
- 12 read-only tools exposed; 13 upstream tools (state writers and
  history-dependent estimators) deliberately excluded
- Loopback local service; strict envelope validation; no state writes of any kind

Relationship: community gift by Kyanite Labs for ResonantOS — canonical
upstream: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/Epoch; this wrapper is non-canonical;
where anything here disagrees with the canonical upstream, the canonical
upstream wins.
